shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Focus indicator for form inputs and action buttons

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Standard action button for primary submit and creation tasks.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background-color: #465fff; color: #ffffff; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 8px; font-family: Outfit, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: #3641f5; }

narrative.overview: Assetika operates on a high-density, clean TailAdmin dashboard pattern optimized for IT and General Affairs operations. The UI prioritizes visual hierarchy, explicit status signals, and rapid data scanning over decorative embellishments.
keyCharacteristics: High scanability with clear tabular layouts and status badges.
Cohesive brand accent #465fff guiding interactive and active states.
Clean typography utilizing Outfit for display and data density.
Native dark mode adaptation across all cards, sidebars, and data tables.

rules.name: The Single Accent Rule
rules.body: Electric Indigo (#465fff) is strictly reserved for primary user actions and selected navigation items. Status badges use semantic colors exclusively.

dos: Do use uppercase 12px Outfit Medium for table headers and badge text.
Do maintain high visual contrast in status badges with semi-transparent background tints.
Do apply --shadow-focus-ring on custom interactive element focus states.
donts: Don't use multi-color gradients for action buttons; keep primary actions solid #465fff.
Don't mix non-Outfit fonts unless displaying raw code snippets.
Don't omit dark mode variants on custom components.
